entries: The plan is simple: {first}, a {trait} {job}, and strangers will lift {THING:valuable} from {landmark:built} {DEADLINE}.
{first}, a {trait} {job} of {place}, gets one night to empty the {rival}'s safe, and {SOMEONE:human,!plural} holds the only key.
After {DISASTER:strikes} wrecks the first plan, {first}, a {trait} {job}, must {DO_THING} {THING} {DEADLINE} with half a crew.
{first}, a {trait} {job}, spends a year planning to hit {landmark:built}, then learns the {rival} is planning the same.
Nobody in {place} trusts {first}, a {trait} {job}, but {SOMEONE:human,!plural} offers a fortune to {DO_THING} {THING} {MANNER}.
{first}, a {trait} {job}, takes a last job for the {rival}: {DO_THING} {THING} {DEADLINE}.
A {trait} {job} named {first} stumbles on {THING:!living,!bulky} {HIDING}, a map to the {rival}'s whole fortune.
{first}, a {trait} {job}, wants the {rival} ruined, and {landmark:built} is where the money sleeps.
A crew gathers in {place}: {first}, a {trait} {job}, {SOMEONE:human,!plural}, and one traitor not yet named.
{first}, a {trait} {job}, reads {MESSAGE:physical} twice and realizes {SOMEONE:human,!plural} is selling that job to the {rival}.
{first}, a {trait} {job} of {place}, retires from crime, until {SOMEONE:human,!plural} turns up {MANNER} with {THING:valuable}.
The {rival} has never been robbed, and {first}, a {trait} {job} of {place}, means to change that {DEADLINE}.
